overview: You looked at the two strokes she had made, beau under bien and sire under madame, and you left the leaf on the table. You did not write a price, and you did not take the chronicle.

parties.name: Jacqueline Field
parties.context: Her pen and her two corrections were on the leaf.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the strokes, and left them.

assets.name: Love's Labour's Lost
assets.disposition: Looked at her two corrections and took the hand off the leaf

summary: Looked at her two corrections and took the hand off the leaf
